description: Authoritative Seofon (Impossible) / Siete HL 4,000,000 Honors (400M Damage) party compositions, character/weapon/summon registries, substitute chains, and readiness verification rules.

entryMechanics.nonFireAllyPenalty: Instantly deals 999,999 plain damage to all non-Fire allies upon battle entry or frontline appearance, bypassing Guts and Unchallenged.
entryMechanics.summonLockNotes: Upon entering battle, all equipped and supporter summons have their cooldowns set to 99 turns (or locked). Passive Main/Supporter Auras and Sub-Auras remain 100% active, making passive cap-up and stat summons mandatory.
entryMechanics.fatedChainBossMechanic: Seofon possesses an enemy Fated Chain (FC) bar that fills whenever he executes a special attack or crosses HP thresholds (80%, 60%, 40%, 20%). At 100% FC, he unleashes Infinito Creare.

coreOmens.name: Emblema
coreOmens.cancelCondition: Deal 77,777,777 damage in a single turn
coreOmens.failurePenalty: Prepares Cien Mil Espadas on the following turn and increases enemy FC bar.
coreOmens.counterStrategy: Unleash Percival (Grand) Sk3 (Schlacht) Tri-Strike burst, Wilnas double Sk2 nuke, or a 5-6 Charge Attack Kengo chain to exceed 77.7M turn damage.

coreOmens.name: Cien Mil Espadas
coreOmens.japaneseName: シエン・ミル・エスパーダ
coreOmens.trigger: Next turn after uncanceled Emblema or 80%/60%/40% HP thresholds
coreOmens.cancelCondition: Execute Fatal Chain (FC) or deal 77,777,777 damage
coreOmens.failurePenalty: Deals heavy multi-hit Wind damage, grants Seofon 2-turn Invincibility (Damage Immunity), and inflicts Slashed/Skill Delay.
coreOmens.counterStrategy: Cancel with Fatal Chain (Kengo setups) or guard through while Satyr Innocent Heart auto-heals and auto-dispels.

coreOmens.name: Infinito Creare
coreOmens.japaneseName: インフィニート・クレアーレ
coreOmens.cancelCondition: Deal 77,777,777 damage in a single turn
coreOmens.failurePenalty: Deals 45,000+ raidwide Wind damage, extends player summon cooldowns, and grants Seofon Miriade di Illusioni.
coreOmens.counterStrategy: Push 77.7M burst turn to cancel, or use Paladin/Satyr/Athena damage cuts and Guard.

coreOmens.name: Cinco Mil Espadas
coreOmens.japaneseName: シンコ・ミル・エスパーダ
coreOmens.cancelCondition: Deal 77,777,777 damage in a single turn
coreOmens.failurePenalty: Inflicts heavy Wind damage, dispels all party buffs, and applies Doom/Skill Seal.
coreOmens.counterStrategy: Cancel via 77.7M turn damage or maintain Satyr/Michael/Lucifer Lv250 Dispel Cancel and Veil.

coreOmens.name: Cuatro Mil Espadas / Siete Espadas (10% Trigger)
coreOmens.japaneseName: クアトロ・ミル・エスパーダ / シエテ・エスパーダ
coreOmens.cancelCondition: Deal 77,777,777 damage or Fatal Chain (Uncancelable plain wipe variant at 10%)
coreOmens.failurePenalty: Deals 99,999 plain damage to all allies (party wipe).
coreOmens.counterStrategy: For 4M Blue Chest racing, reach 4,000,000 honors before 10% HP. For Host/Solo clear, survive with Paladin Sacred Protection, Yamato Seawall, Fenie Phoenix revive, or Anderson/Ragazzo Substitute.

hardGates.name: 100% Fire Element Roster & Party Enforcement
hardGates.description: Seofon immediately deals 999,999 plain damage to any non-Fire character upon battle entry. All frontline and backline characters must be Fire element.

hardGates.name: Turn-1 99-Turn Summon Cooldown Lock Compliance
hardGates.description: Seofon locks all active summon calls to 99 turns on entry. Grids and rotations must rely on passive Main/Supporter Auras (Agni, Colossus Ira, Lucifer, Beelzebub Trance) and passive Sub-Auras (Michael, The Sun, Belial, Wilnas).

hardGates.name: Survivable HP & Defense Threshold
hardGates.description: Party HP must be at least 45,000 for 2-3T Burst setups and at least 65,000 for Full Auto / Kengo / Host setups to withstand Seofon's multi-hit Wind normal attacks.

hardGates.name: 77,777,777 Omen Cancel & 4,000,000 Honors Pacing Check
hardGates.description: Party composition and weapon grid must either exceed 77,777,777 peak turn damage to cancel Emblema or sustain >= 400,000,000 total damage (4,000,000 honors) within 2 to 6 turns.

characterRegistry.name: Percival (Grand)
characterRegistry.japaneseName: パーシヴァル (リミテッド)
keySkillsForSiete: Sk3 (Schlacht): Grants all Fire allies 1-turn Tri-Strike (attack 3 times without advancing turn), 30% Fire Echo, and 20% Fire Amplification (requires Singed Lv7+).
Sk1 (X-Seele): Inflicts Singed stacks and auto-activates at end of turn when foe uses special attack.
Sk2 (Regieren): 5-hit Fire nuke + Dispel + unchallenged.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Single most impactful character for Siete 4M Honors burst. His Sk3 (Schlacht) allows the entire Fire frontline to attack 3 times in a single turn, effortlessly clearing the 77,777,777 Emblema omen and generating ~1.5M-2.2M honors in 1 turn alone.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Provides Turn 1-3 guaranteed TA, Echoes, and Crit field, though lacks 1-turn Tri-Strike.
Massive individual Ougi + double Sk2 nuke output (~35M/turn), but does not grant teamwide Tri-Strike.
Strong multiattack, Foxflame support, and double strike/echo utility.

characterRegistry.name: Zeta (Grand)
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1 (Rhongomyniad): Grants 1-turn Salted Wound (Assassin) and 100% TA.
Sk2 (Infinite Wonders) & Sk3 (Scarlet Vow): Multi-hit Fire skill nukes and dispels that can be cast multiple times.
Passive (Crimson Spear): Unconditional Guaranteed Triple Attack (no charge attack) with 25% Normal Attack Amplification.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Pairs with Percival (Grand) and Manadiver/Sumaibito for the fastest 2-turn 4M Honors setup in the game. Because she never Charge Attacks on normal turns, she eliminates Ougi lockout while dealing 40M-80M+ per turn.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Slightly slower animation lockout due to Ougi, but matches or exceeds raw per-turn damage in Full Auto.
Extreme skill nuke spammer in early turns and can sacrifice to bring in Alanaan FLB or Fraux FLB.
High multi-hit normal attack + echo synergy.

characterRegistry.name: Wilnas (Grand)
characterRegistry.japaneseName: ウィルナス (リミテッド)
keySkillsForSiete: Ougi (Magma Chamber): Deals massive 6.6M-8.5M CA damage and makes next Sk2 activate twice.
Sk2 (Hadron Buster): Massive Fire nuke + Dispel + Singed stack; auto-triggered or double-cast after Ougi for 16M+ skill damage.
Passive (Flame Dragon's Majesty): Immune to all debuffs, +100% ATK, +100% DEF, +50% Damage Cap, and amplifies Fire allies' damage.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Cornerstone of both 3-4 Turn Full Auto Blue Chest and Kengo Ougi setups. His complete debuff immunity ignores Seofon's Slashed/Doom/Skill Seal debuffs, while his Ougi + double Sk2 combo deals 30M-45M+ damage per turn by himself.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Superior for manual/0-lockout normal attack burst; slightly less tanky in long Full Auto.
Strong tank + counter-nuke omen solver for Full Auto.
Strong Ougi battery and defensive utility for Kengo/FA.

characterRegistry.name: Michael (Grand)
keySkillsForSiete: Passive 1 (Archangel's Blessing - Sub-Ally or Frontline): +20% Fire Damage Cap and +10% boost to Fire weapon skills (Normal/Omega/EX).
Sk1 (Sacred Wing): Grants targeted Fire ally +50% Charge Bar, 1-turn Skill Cooldown Cut, Veil, and Dispel Cancel.
Sk3 (Flaming Sword): Deals 1.5M plain damage, dispels 2 buffs, delays, and inflicts 25% Fire DEF Down.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Mandatory in 100% of Fire Siete teams (either in Sub-Ally Slot 1 for unconditional +20% Damage Cap & +10% Weapon Skill boost, or on the Frontline for Kengo/Full Auto Veil + Dispel Cancel + CD cut).

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Provides backline supplemental Ougi nuke or frontline Double Ougi buff, but cannot replace Michael's passive +20% Cap.
Provides debuff extension and healing utility.

characterRegistry.name: Satyr (Fire)
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1 (Advent Twinkle): Grants all Fire allies permanent unremovable +30% ATK, +50% DEF, +50% CA DMG, +20% CA Cap, and 15% DMG reduction.
Sk2 (Innocent Heart): Heals all allies (up to 3,000 HP), cleanses 1 debuff, and grants +15% charge bar; auto-casts when Seofon uses a special attack.
Sk3 (Performance Mode): Multi-hit Fire nuke + 2-buff Dispel + 25% ATK/DEF Down.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Undisputed MVP for Siete Kengo Ougi Loop, Full Auto Sustain, and Host/Solo clears. Every time Seofon triggers Emblema, Cien Mil Espadas, or Infinito Creare, Satyr automatically heals the party, cleanses debuffs, and fuels continuous Ougi chains.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Offers Phoenix auto-revive, massive healing, and debuff immunity.
Strong double-cast heal + cleanse + dispel in Full Auto.
Provides Wind switch, 40% Wind Cut, and auto-nuke counter.

characterRegistry.name: Alanaan (FLB)
characterRegistry.japaneseName: アラナン (最終上限解放)
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1 (Renunciation - FLB): Deploys Renunciation field (+30% Unique ATK, +25% DEF Down) and activates Sk2 effects without consuming charge bar at Lv100.
Sk2 (Blazing Sun): Grants all Fire allies 100% TA and 50% Fire Bonus Damage (Echo) for 4 turns.
Sk4 (Solar Blessing - 4th Skill): Grants massive Critical Hit Rate, Keen (50,000 supplemental), and Fire Amplification.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: At Lv100 FLB with his 4th Skill unlocked, Alanaan removes the old 100% charge bar drain requirement and turns any Manadiver/Berserker + Percival/Zeta frontline into a 2-turn 4M Honors juggernaut.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Zero Ougi lockout, teamwide Foxflame amplification, 3-hit Flurry out-of-turn TA, and Sabre/Katana World Harp synergy.
Zero setup required; higher personal Ougi/skill damage on Full Auto.

characterRegistry.name: Fraux (FLB)
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1 (Red Sphere) & Sk2 (Nightmare): Double-cast heavy Fire nukes with Dispel and local debuff extension.
Sk3 (Indomitable): Heals all allies up to 8,000 HP (double-cast) and cleanses 2 debuffs.
Sk4 (Crimson Devil): Grants permanent double skill activation and end-of-turn auto-nuke.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Exceptional Full Auto anchor for 4-5 turn Blue Chest and full solo runs. Her double-cast 8,000 HP heal + 2-debuff cleanse + 2-buff dispel completely neutralizes Seofon's mid-phase pressure.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Satyr triggers reactively on enemy special attacks without needing Evoker uncap materials.
Grand Fenie provides similar top-tier sustain + auto-revive.

characterRegistry.name: Silva (Yukata)
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1 (Shimmering Shell): Grants targeted Fire ally (usually Kengo MC or Wilnas) 5-turn CA Reactivation (Double Ougi), +50% CA DMG, and +30% CA Cap.
Passive 1 (Five-Star Shot): Deals 6-hit Fire skill damage and inflicts Accuracy Down at end of turn whenever allies perform 5 or more Charge Attacks.
Passive 2 (Backline Support): Deals extra Fire nuke at end of turn whenever a 4+ Chain Burst occurs.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Core engine of the Fire Kengo Ougi Loop for Siete. By granting Double Ougi to a second ally alongside Kengo MC, the party easily fires 5-6 Charge Attacks every turn, triggering her end-of-turn nuke, charging Fatal Chain every 2 turns, and breaking 77,777,777 damage.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Holiday Noa provides partywide charge bar + CA specs + unchallenged.
Yukata Mirin provides 200% charge bar double Ougi andveil/heal.

characterRegistry.name: Fenie (Grand)
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1 (Wings of Rebirth): Substitute-All; upon being knocked out, automatically revives with Phoenix blessing, unlocking triple-attack/multi-nuke mode.
Sk2 & Sk3: Massive party heal, debuff cleanse, and multi-hit skill damage.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Can tank lethal triggers (including Cien Mil Espadas or 10% Cuatro Mil Espadas) via Substitute-All, auto-revive via Phoenix passive, and then unleash massive multi-hit skill/normal damage every turn.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Consistent reactive healing and dispel on every special attack.
300% DEF + Substitute-All tanking.

characterRegistry.name: Ragazzo
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1 & Sk2: Repeated multi-hit Fire nukes that consume HP to deal 30M+ skill damage in 1-2 turns.
Passive (Bloody Crimson): Automatically sacrifices himself after his stack threshold to bring a backline Evoker (Alanaan FLB or Fraux FLB) to the frontline with Upright upright buff active.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Dual-purpose unit in Siete: either unloads massive Turn 1-2 skill damage before dying cleanly on Turn 2/3 to bring out Alanaan FLB/Fraux FLB with full Evoker switch-in passives, or acts as a budget burst attacker.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Higher sustained burst without self-KO.
Stays on frontline with consistent TA and echoes.

characterRegistry.name: Yuel (Grand)
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1 & Sk2: Multi-hit Fire damage, DATA up, and teamwide Fire Bonus Damage (Echo) + Fire ATK Up.
Sk3: Party heal + debuff clear.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Excellent accessible frontline attacker/buffer when paired with Percival (Grand). Her teamwide Echoes and Fire ATK Up multiply Percival's Tri-Strike turn to easily clear 77,777,777 damage.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Grand Zeta deals higher individual damage.
Alanaan FLB provides stronger teamwide Echo + TA.

characterRegistry.name: Anderson
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1 & Sk2: Multi-hit skill nukes with Delay and self-heal.
Sk3: Substitute-All with 300% DEF Up and Unchallenged.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Great non-limited frontline bruiser for Full Auto and Host setups; absorbs Seofon's multi-hit normal attacks and Cien Mil Espadas while retaliating with heavy skill counters.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Wilnas offers higher raw burst damage.
Athena provides teamwide Wind cut and auto-nukes.

characterRegistry.name: Noa (Holiday)
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1: Inflicts DEF Down and Dispel.
Sk2: Grants party Unchallenged (1 time) and Dispel Cancel.
Sk3: Boosts party Charge Bar Gain and CA Specs.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Top-tier partner for Fire Kengo Ougi loops alongside Satyr and Wilnas/Silva. His partywide Unchallenged + Dispel Cancel can completely negate Cinco Mil Espadas or 10% triggers.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Yukata Silva provides higher offensive CA frequency.
Michael provides Veil + Dispel Cancel + +20% Cap.

characterRegistry.name: Medusa (Holiday / Valentine / Fire)
keySkillsForSiete: Auto-casts multi-hit Fire skill nukes when enemy uses special attacks or when Primal Pals allies are present.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Strong Full Auto partner with Satyr (Primal Pals synergy), providing continuous reactive multi-hit skill damage.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Holiday Nemone provides end-of-turn buffs and auto-nukes.
Athena also shares Primal Pals synergy with Satyr.

characterRegistry.name: Nemone (Holiday)
keySkillsForSiete: Passively casts multi-hit Fire nuke and buffs party ATK/DEF/DATA/Healing at end of every turn.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Zero-click Full Auto workhorse that steadily deals 8M-12M extra skill damage at the end of every turn while buffering the team.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Fraux FLB provides stronger targeted healing and dispels.
Accessible non-limited sustain alternative.

characterRegistry.name: Athena
keySkillsForSiete: Sk1 (Aegis): 40% Wind DMG Cut + Wind Switch.
Sk2 (Tetradrachm): 10-hit Fire nuke + Fire DEF Down; auto-triggers when targeted.
Ougi: Grants party Veil and Fire ATK Up at Lv100.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Best F2P/Classic suptix defensive frontline option when paired with Satyr for Full Auto or Kengo setups.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Satyr provides superior healing and dispel frequency.

characterRegistry.name: Mirin (Yukata)
keySkillsForSiete: 200% Charge Bar cap allowing Double Charge Attacks in Kengo setups; provides party heal and Veil.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Strong substitute for Yukata Silva or Holiday Noa in Fire Kengo Ougi loops to reach 5-6 Charge Attacks per turn.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Yukata Silva adds end-of-turn 5-CA nuke.

characterRegistry.name: Tien / Esser (Transcendence 130-150)
keySkillsForSiete: Sk2 (Last Order) & Sk3 (Stardust): 10-hit Fire nuke + Guaranteed TA + 30% Fire Echo.
characterRegistry.sieteSynergyNotes: Strong F2P Eternal burst option at Transcendence Lv130-150 if missing Grand Zeta or Grand Wilnas.

substitutes.tradeoffNotes: Grand Zeta requires zero Eternal transcendence materials.

weaponRegistry.name: Lord of Flames
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: ロード・オブ・フレイム
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Resonator (Crimson Vow): When 4 or more weapons of the same type are equipped in the grid, grants +40% EX ATK, +25% DEF, and +7% Special Damage Cap per copy (up to +20% Cap). Works in both Agni and Magna grids!

substitutes.notes: Attack Awakening Extinction Blade provides +15% Normal ATK and +5% Cap without 4-of-a-kind restriction.
Core Magna 3 Exalted Sword.

weaponRegistry.name: Crimson Scale
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: クリムゾン・スケール
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Pact of the Archangel: Unconditionally grants +50,000 Supplemental Damage (up to 100,000 with 2 copies) and +7% Damage Cap per copy in both Primal and Magna grids. Huge multiplier for multi-hit characters like Zeta, Percival, and Manadiver.

substitutes.notes: Special Awakening Extinction Blade grants CA/Skill supplemental and cap.
Astral Axe provides EX ATK and Auto Cap.

weaponRegistry.name: Overrider
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Primal Glory + Normal Attack Cap + Supplemental damage. Exceptional mainhand for Manadiver/Spartan or grid slot in Agni burst grids.

substitutes.notes: Luin provides mainhand Echo and ignition.
Lord of Flames covers cap and EX ATK.

weaponRegistry.name: Ira Volcanic Blade
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: コロッサス・アイラ・ブレード (マグナ3剣)
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Backbone of Magna 3 Fire grids. 3 copies with Colossus Ira Lv250 provide 100% Critical Hit Rate, massive Exalted Omega ATK, and Sword count for Lord of Flames Resonator.

substitutes.notes: M2 Ancient Ecke Sachs provides Omega Crit + Enmity as a mid-game fallback.
Nilakantha provides Omega Stamina + HP.

weaponRegistry.name: Extinction Blade
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Farmed from Mugen (Impossible). Attack Awakening Lv20 gives +3,500 Raw ATK, +15% Normal ATK, and +5% DMG Cap; Special Awakening Lv20 gives +10% Special Cap and +30% CA DMG; Defense Awakening gives +40% DEF and +15% HP.

substitutes.notes: M3 Exalted Sword.
Shiva M2 Staff for HP and Stamina.

weaponRegistry.name: Scythe of Repentance
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: 絶対否定の鎌 / 永遠拒絶の鎌 (終末の神器)
recommendedPendulumKeys: Skill Cap / Auto Cap / CA Cap
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Mandatory in 100% of grids. At ULB Lv200+ / Transcendence Lv230-250, provides massive ATK/HP, +10-50% Cap (Key 2), and Extremity/Stamina/Falsehood (Key 3).

weaponRegistry.name: Ultima Sword / Axe / Spear (Lv 200)
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: オメガウェポン (5凸 Lv200)
recommendedPendulumKeys: Auto Cap / Skill Cap / CA Cap
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Lv200 Ultima with Gauph Key Tria provides +25% Seraphic Amplification against Wind (replacing Sword of Michael) plus +10% Normal Cap or +50% Skill Cap.

substitutes.notes: Sword of Michael provides +23% Seraphic Amp if Ultima Lv200 Tria Key is not yet unlocked.

weaponRegistry.name: Unsigned Kaneshige (Fire)
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Mandatory Mainhand for the Fire Kengo Ougi Loop archetype. Grants +50% Charge Bar Gain to all allies on MC Ougi, enabling 5-6 Charge Attacks every single turn.

substitutes.notes: Can mainhand in non-Kengo setups, but Kengo requires Kaneshige for infinite loop.

weaponRegistry.name: Luin
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Strong Spear/Staff mainhand option granting teamwide Echoes and charge bar manipulation.

substitutes.notes: Overrider is strictly stronger in Primal grids.
Dark Opus mainhand.

weaponRegistry.name: Heat of The Sun
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: ヒート・オブ・ザ・サン
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Provides EX ATK, Fire Damage Cap, and auto-nuke / damage amplification when mainhanded by Manadiver or Monk.

substitutes.notes: Sol Shreck Astral Axe.

weaponRegistry.name: Sol Shreck
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: ソル・レムナント (アストラル斧)
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: ULB Lv200 provides +37% EX ATK and +10% Normal Attack Damage Cap (or +20% when mainhanded by Berserker/Viking).

substitutes.notes: Lord of Flames provides +40% EX ATK and +7% All Cap.

weaponRegistry.name: Nilakantha
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: ニーラカンタ (シヴァ杖)
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Provides Omega Stamina + Omega Majesty (ATK & HP). Great HP stabilizer in Magna grids to pass the 65,000 HP survival gate.

substitutes.notes: M3 Sword.

weaponRegistry.name: Ancient Ecke Sachs
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: オールド・エッケザックス
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Budget F2P Sword providing Omega Crit + Enmity + Sabre count for Lord of Flames if Ira Volcanic Blades are not yet farmed.

substitutes.notes: Direct upgrade in Magna 3.

weaponRegistry.name: Al-Abad
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: アル・アバド (アトゥム杖)
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Grants up to +400,000 Charge Attack Supplemental Damage. Excellent F2P slot in Fire Kengo Ougi grids before Extinction Blades are finished.

substitutes.notes: Special Awakening Extinction Blade.

weaponRegistry.name: Sword of Michael
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: ミカエル・ソード (天司武器)
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Provides +23% Seraphic Damage Amplification against Wind foes and counts as a Sabre for Resonator skills if Ultima Lv200 Tria Key is not slotted.

substitutes.notes: Ultima Lv200 with Tria Key provides +25% Seraphic Amp.

weaponRegistry.name: Torch of Eternal Flames (Fenie Staff)
weaponRegistry.japaneseName: 不死鳥の灯火 (フェニー杖)
weaponRegistry.sieteNotes: Top-tier Manadiver/Monk/Iatromantis mainhand and Agni sustain weapon providing massive HP, Skill Cap, and end-of-turn auto-heal/nuke.

substitutes.notes: Heat of The Sun Staff.

summonRegistry.name: Agni (Lv 200-250)
summonRegistry.sieteNotes: Boosts Primal Fire weapon skills by 150%-170% passively. Works 100% through Seofon's Turn-1 99-turn summon cooldown lock.

summonRegistry.name: Colossus Ira Omega (Lv 200-250)
summonRegistry.japaneseName: コロッサス・マグナ (超越 Lv250)
summonRegistry.sieteNotes: Boosts Omega Fire weapon skills by 140%-170% passively. Works 100% through Seofon's Turn-1 99-turn summon cooldown lock.

summonRegistry.name: Lucifer (Transcendence Lv 250)
summonRegistry.sieteNotes: Passive Main/Support Aura grants +150% Fire Elemental ATK, +50% Max HP, and automatically cleanses 1 debuff + grants Wings of Pure White when Seofon uses a special attack—even while its active call is locked!

summonRegistry.name: Beelzebub / Versusia
summonRegistry.japaneseName: ベルゼバブ / ヴェルサシア
summonRegistry.sieteNotes: CRITICAL SIETE NOTE: Seofon locks Beelzebub's active Call to 99 turns on Turn 1! However, if equipped as Main Summon, Beelzebub's passive Main Aura still starts MC at Trance Lv3 (+50% Unique ATK, 100% TA, +20% Damage Cap).

summonRegistry.name: Michael (Archangel Summon)
summonRegistry.sieteNotes: Passive Sub-Aura grants +10% to +15% Fire Damage Cap unconditionally. Unaffected by Seofon's summon cooldown lock.

summonRegistry.name: The Sun (ULB Lv 200)
summonRegistry.sieteNotes: Mandatory Sub-Aura granting +10% Seraphic Damage Amplification against Wind foes. Note: Its Turn-1 Double Strike active call is blocked by Seofon's 99T entry lock, so Double/Tri-Strike must come from Percival Sk3 instead.

summonRegistry.name: Belial
summonRegistry.sieteNotes: Passive Sub-Aura adds +30,000 Supplemental Damage to every single damage instance. Multiplies massively with Percival Tri-Strike, Zeta echoes, and Manadiver multi-hits.

summonRegistry.name: Wilnas (Six Dragons Summon)
summonRegistry.sieteNotes: Passive Sub-Aura boosts Agni/Optimus Fire weapon skills by +20% to +40%. Essential in Primal Agni grids.

summonRegistry.name: The Devil (ULB Lv 200)
summonRegistry.sieteNotes: Passive Sub-Aura grants +30% Max HP to all Fire allies. Crucial for meeting the 65,000+ HP survival threshold in Full Auto and Host setups.

summonRegistry.name: Triple Zero (000)
summonRegistry.sieteNotes: Passive Sub-Aura grants +10% Perpetuity ATK and +5% Damage Cap to all allies even while its active call is locked on entry.

partyArchetypes.name: Fire Manadiver / Percival 2-3 Turn Blue Chest Burst

frontlineSlots.slotNotes: Percival Sk3 (Schlacht) provides the 1-turn Tri-Strike + Echo + Amplification needed to deal 160M-220M damage in a single burst turn.
Grand Zeta deals 80M+ across 2 turns with 0 Ougi lockout and cancels 77.7M Emblema effortlessly.

frontlineSlots.slotRole: Party Echo / Field Buffer or Secondary Nuker
frontlineSlots.slotNotes: Alanaan FLB (Lv100) grants 4-turn 100% TA, +50% Echo, Keen, and Renunciation field on Turn 1 without draining charge bar.

backlineSlots.slotRole: Passive +20% Damage Cap & +10% Weapon Skill Sub-Ally
backlineSlots.slotNotes: Unconditional +20% Fire Damage Cap and +10% Weapon Skill boost from backline.
Stabilizes run if a frontline unit falls on Turn 3.

coreGridSlots.roleLabel: Base Grid Core (Overrider / M3 Ira Volcanic Blade)

turnRotation: Turn 1: Reload entry animation -> Alanaan Sk1/Sk2/Sk4 -> Zeta Sk2/Sk3 -> Percival Sk1/Sk2 -> MC Wild Magica/Secret Triad -> Attack (Cancels 77,777,777 Emblema, ~160M DMG / ~1.6M Honors).
Turn 2: Zeta Sk1 (Assassin) -> Percival Sk3 (Schlacht Tri-Strike) -> Attack & Reload (~220M DMG / ~3.8M Cumulative Honors).
Turn 3: Cast remaining nukes -> Attack & Reload -> Reach 4,000,000+ Honors (~410M+ Total Damage) -> Exit / Next Raid.
partyArchetypes.strategySummary: Fastest 4M Honors Blue Chest snipe setup for Seofon (Impossible). Bypasses Seofon's Turn-1 summon cooldown lock by relying on passive Agni/Colossus auras, Alanaan FLB field + 50% Echo, Grand Zeta Assassin, and Grand Percival Sk3 Tri-Strike.

partyArchetypes.name: Fire Berserker / Viking 3-5 Turn Full Auto Blue Chest

frontlineSlots.slotNotes: Casts Sk1 -> Sk2 -> Sk3 automatically on Full Auto once Singed reaches Lv7 (or Turn 1 with Wilnas/MC).
Wilnas shrugs off all Seofon debuffs, deals 35M-45M per turn on Full Auto, and stacks Singed rapidly.

frontlineSlots.slotRole: Multi-Hit Skill Nuker / Dispel / Sustain Support
frontlineSlots.slotNotes: Grand Zeta or Grand Michael/Satyr rounds out the frontline to guarantee 90M-120M average damage per turn.

backlineSlots.slotNotes: Provides +20% Fire Damage Cap & +10% Weapon Skill boost.
Steps in if battle extends past Turn 5.

turnRotation: Turn 1: Enable Full Auto (or reload entry -> click Beast Fang + Ulfhedinn -> enable Full Auto) -> Attack & Reload.
Turns 2-4: Full Auto casts Wilnas Ougi + double Sk2, Percival Sk3 Tri-Strike, and Zeta multi-nukes, cancelling 77.7M Emblema triggers automatically.
Turn 4-5: Crosses 4,000,000 Honors (~400M Damage) -> Confirm Result / Next Raid.
partyArchetypes.strategySummary: Hands-free 3-5 Turn Full Auto setup ideal for continuous multi-battle farming. Combines Berserker's Turn-1 200% bar double-Ougi with Grand Wilnas and Grand Percival to obliterate 77.7M omens on Full Auto.

partyArchetypes.name: Fire Kengo Infinite Ougi & Fatal Chain Loop (4-6 Turns to 4M + Carry)

frontlineSlots.slotRole: Reactive Auto-Heal, Auto-Cleanse & Charge Bar Battery
frontlineSlots.slotNotes: Satyr Innocent Heart auto-heals, auto-cleanses, and dispels 2 buffs every time Seofon uses a special attack, while Sk2 supplies +15-30% charge bar.
Yukata Silva Sk1 grants Double Ougi to Wilnas/MC, guaranteeing 5-6 Charge Attacks every turn to fill Fatal Chain every 2 turns.

frontlineSlots.slotRole: Massive Ougi + Post-Ougi Double Skill Nuker
frontlineSlots.slotNotes: With Yukata Silva's Double Ougi buff or Kengo battery, Wilnas fires 8M+ Ougis followed by double 8M+ Hadron Buster nukes every turn.

backlineSlots.slotNotes: Boosts Ougi and Post-Ougi skill damage caps by +20% from the backline.
Backup healer if battle goes to 0% HP.

turnRotation: Turn 1: Satyr Sk1/Sk2 -> Silva Sk1 (target Wilnas) -> Kengo No More Doubt + Rending Flash -> Attack (5-6 Charge Attacks + Wilnas double Sk2 + Silva 5-chain nuke = ~82M DMG, cancels Emblema).
Turn 2-5: Continuous 5-6 Charge Attack loop on Full Auto; Fatal Chain fills every 2 turns to cancel Cien Mil Espadas.
Turn 5: Reaches 4,000,000+ Honors with 100% HP across all allies; can either reload-snipe or stay to solo/finish the raid.
partyArchetypes.strategySummary: The gold-standard safe 4M Honors & Raid Carry composition.Unsigned Kaneshige + Satyr + Yukata Silva + Wilnas fires 5-6 Charge Attacks + multiple post-Ougi nukes every turn, effortlessly exceeding 77,777,777 damage while generating Fatal Chains every 2 turns.

partyArchetypes.name: Fire Monk / Lumberjack / Iatromantis Full Auto Skill & Sustain

frontlineSlots.slotNotes: Keeps party healthy and debuff-free on 100% Full Auto.
Provides burst spikes to cross 77.7M triggers.
Fraux FLB or Holiday Nemone/Medusa provides end-of-turn skill damage and sustain.

backlineSlots.slotNotes: Boosts all skill and normal damage caps by +20%.

turnRotation: Turn 1: Enable Full Auto immediately upon entering battle.
Turns 1-6: Monk/Lumberjack end-of-turn auto-nukes combine with Satyr, Percival/Wilnas, and Fraux/Nemone to steadily accumulate 700k-900k honors per turn while tanking all triggers.
Turn 6: Reaches 4,000,000+ Honors safely with zero manual intervention.
partyArchetypes.strategySummary: Accessible, ultra-safe 100% Full Auto setup for players transitioning from M2/early M3 or running hands-free background farming.

partyArchetypes.name: Fire Paladin / Yamato Daily Host & 10% Execute Solver

frontlineSlots.slotNotes: Handles continuous healing and debuff cleansing throughout 100%-0% HP.
Grand Fenie or Anderson/Noa absorbs or survives the 10% Cuatro Mil Espadas 99,999 plain damage trigger.
Provides the burst damage needed to cancel Infinito Creare and Cinco Mil Espadas.

backlineSlots.slotNotes: Enters after 10% trigger to finish the final 250M HP.

turnRotation: Phase 1 (100%-50%): Host raid -> Secure 4,000,000 Honors safely using Satyr sustain and Percival/Wilnas omen cancels -> Open Backup Request.
Phase 2 (50%-10%): Use Paladin Sacred Protection / Elemental Phalanx or Satyr dispels to navigate Cinco Mil Espadas.
Phase 3 (10%-0%): Tank 10% Cuatro Mil Espadas via Fenie Sk1 Substitute-All (Phoenix auto-revive), Anderson Sk3, or Yamato Seawall -> Execute final 10% HP.
partyArchetypes.strategySummary: Designed for daily hosts and full 100%-0% raid carries. Combines Defense-awakened Extinction Blades (75,000+ HP) with Paladin/Yamato mitigation and Fenie/Anderson 10% wipe protection.
